title: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Closed-Loop Withdrawal Verification
precondition: Investor funded via Bank Wire; requests withdrawal to Crypto wallet.
expected_result: Rejected by AML engine: 'Withdrawal must return to original funding source (Bank Wire)'; compliance flag logged.
actual_result: AML engine enforces closed-loop payout rule: Withdrawals must return to the original deposit funding source.
